Score Gaze against owner-side annotated JSONL without printing document text

Usage: gaze eval [OPTIONS] <ANNOTATED>

Arguments:
  <ANNOTATED>  Owner-side JSONL corpus with text and UTF-8 byte spans

Options:
      --policy <POLICY>        Policy TOML; absent means the same bundled core policy as `gaze clean`
      --locale <LOCALE>        Active locale fallback chain, comma separated and priority ordered
      --label-map <LABEL_MAP>  JSON object mapping corpus labels to Gaze policy class names
      --json                   Emit machine-readable aggregate metrics
  -h, --help                   Print help
